correctness.rationale: Exact independent-root-split recurrences lead to a mixed-moment ODE with unique power-series solution; subtracting exact means gives covariance for all n>=2. Exact n=7 bivariate distribution recurrence supplies rational CDF crossing. Standard second-moment recurrences yield variance constants, hence asymptotic correlation. The standalone checker enumerates 8! permutations, checks bivariate recursion and 100 sizes of exact moment identities; finite checks corroborate, not replace, the proof.

value.rationale: Terminal-node count measures branching/shape while internal path length measures sorting/search cost. Their exact finite negative covariance and vanishing Pearson correlation distinguish absolute dependence from asymptotic decorrelation; the n=7 crossing rules out the tempting stronger monotone conditional-risk interpretation. This is a natural two-statistic dependence question, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
